# [ShadowClaw DAW](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-daw/)

> In-browser Digital Audio Workstation template powered by ShadowClaw. Features zero-dependency Web Audio API synthesis, General MIDI SoundFont 2 engine, non-destructive & offline audio editing (FFT/STFT spectral restoration, WSOLA time/pitch stretch, label tracks), autonomous song composition, TC39 Signals, 15 mobile-first Web Components, 50 declarative WebMCP tools, and autonomous agent skills.

## Workbench & Interactive Surface

- [Interactive Workbench](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-daw/main/): Real-time Web Audio API synthesis, SoundFont instruments, interactive timeline & waveform/spectrogram editor, Plot Spectrum analyzer, step sequencer, DX7 synth workbench, mixer console with peak meters, and offline WAV bouncing.

## Documentation Guides

- [Architecture](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-daw/main/architecture/): Four-tier runtime architecture, pure-JS DSP/spectral/WSOLA kernels, optional Worker/WASM acceleration, composition engine, SoundFont synthesis, Web Audio graph, lookahead scheduler, OPFS storage, and signal reactivity.
- [WebMCP Tools](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-daw/main/tools/): 50 declarative `scdaw_*` tools for agentic music production, audio import/editing/DSP/analysis/labels, autonomous song composition, SoundFont synthesis, mix analysis, MIDI/DAWproject interchange, and stem exports.
- [Agent Skills](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-daw/main/skills/): Autonomous slash skills (`/song`, `/beat`, `/jam`, `/acid-jam`, `/trap-beat`, `/lofi-session`, `/soundfont-orchestra`, `/mixdown`, `/bounce`, `/scdaw-status`, `/scdaw-doctor`, `/scdaw-automate`, `/scdaw-audio-clip`, `/audio-editing`, `/scdaw-record`).
- [Workbench UI](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-daw/main/workbench/): 15 mobile-first custom elements (`<scdaw-workbench>`, `<scdaw-transport>`, `<scdaw-browser>`, `<scdaw-timeline>`, `<scdaw-editor>`, `<scdaw-wave-editor>`, `<scdaw-spectrum>`, `<scdaw-sequencer>`, `<scdaw-synth>`, `<scdaw-devices>`, `<scdaw-mixer>`, `<scdaw-knob>`, `<scdaw-resize-handle>`, `<scdaw-statusbar>`, `<scdaw-midi-keyboard>`).
- [Porting & Attribution](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-daw/main/porting-and-attribution/): Provenance ledger and porting map from openDAW (AGPL-3.0-or-later) and Audacity (GPLv3/GPLv2+).
- [Troubleshooting](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-daw/main/troubleshooting/): Browser audio autoplay policy, recording error recovery, audio import/WASM fallbacks, Web MIDI, URL song sharing, leader election, and offline bounce tips.
- [Song Showcase & Examples](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw-daw/main/examples/): Live public-domain demos and zero-dependency Python `#file=` share URL pipeline.

## Related

- [ShadowClaw](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw/llms.txt): Core dual-runtime AI assistant framework.
- [openDAW](https://github.com/andremichelle/openDAW): Web audio workstation source reference.
- [Audacity](https://github.com/audacity/audacity): Non-destructive clip editing, spectral restoration, analysis, and label-track DSP reference.
